name: Signed Distance Field from Mesh
definition: Rendering triangle meshes by converting them into Signed Distance Fields (SDFs). The MeshSDF class wraps an STL file and provides an implicit function f(point) -> scalar that returns the signed distance to the mesh surface.
summary: Signed Distance Field from Mesh converts triangulated surfaces into implicit functions by evaluating exact Euclidean distances directly from geometry, avoiding the rasterization artifacts of slice-based voxelization.
